output.reason: [ev-78dda4f7a9cf] on its own is just the metric name. The section lead-in [ev-1f419676f177] gives what it is missing. It says this listed metric, which starts with `cortex_`, will start with `loki_` in 3.0.0, so it becomes `loki_query_frontend_retries_sum`. It also says that operators who set `metrics_namespace` from the default `loki` to `cortex` keep the old prefix, which tells us which environments are exposed. Finally, it says that setting is deprecated and will be removed in the next minor release, after which the prefix will be `loki`. That covers the subject, change, applicability and consequence: an exposed environment that does nothing will see the metric under the new `loki_` name.
